Send later

The message is built now and held on this computer until the time you pick, so the app has to be running for it to go out. Nothing is sent from the server on your behalf.

Sales team

Who mail can be assigned to. Each person gets a colour and initials that appear on every message they are handling.

Add someone
Sharing across the team

POP3 keeps no shared state, so assignments travel through a file every machine can reach — a network share or a synced folder. Point every copy of the app at the same path. Leave it empty to keep everything on this computer only.

Settings

Identity
Password

Changed your mail password? Enter the new one. It is checked with the server first and kept in Windows Credential Manager, never in the app's files.

Signatures

Saved signatures are shared by every account. The default is inserted automatically when you start a new message; you can pick a different one, or none, while composing.

Mail on the server
Junk filter

Rules

Rules run on new mail as it arrives, in order, before the junk filter. Nothing is deleted outright — "Delete" moves to Deleted Items.

Add a rule

Junk options

These lists are decisions, not guesses, so they beat everything else the filter works out — including when the filter itself is switched off. Enter a full address, or a bare domain to cover everyone there.

Import from Outlook

Where should it go?
Folders in this file

Nothing in Outlook is changed or deleted. Mail already here is skipped, and the junk filter is not applied to imported mail. Outlook stores calendar items, contacts and tasks in the same file; those are not mail and are left behind.
